ideas.pitch: A hybrid classical-quantum traffic routing simulation using IBM Qiskit to optimize signal timings and reduce congestion in Bengaluru intersections.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore real-world applications of quantum computing to solve practical logistics and optimization challenges.
ideas.title: Q-Traffic Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Quantum Innovation Award by tackling a massive local pain point in Bengaluru (traffic) using IBM Qiskit, aligning with the primary sponsor's ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: A quantum-assisted molecular docking simulator leveraging VQE (Variational Quantum Eigensolver) to predict drug-protein binding affinities faster than classical approximations.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore real-world applications of quantum computing in computational biology and healthcare.
ideas.title: EntangleMed
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-difficulty quantum algorithms with healthcare, giving judges a demonstration of genuinely hard engineering applied to a high-impact sector for the Quantum Impact Award.

ideas.pitch: A quantum portfolio optimization tool using QAOA (Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm) to balance risk and return under volatile market conditions.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore real-world applications of quantum computing in financial modeling and resource allocation.
ideas.title: Q-Ported Portfolio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Q-Hack India Champion track by featuring a complete end-to-end pipeline with a live-working Qiskit backend and a clean financial dashboard that judges can interact with directly.

ideas.pitch: A quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol visualizer and lattice-based cryptography demonstration platform for secure IoT communications.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore real-world applications of quantum computing in cybersecurity and post-quantum cryptography.
ideas.title: Kitsune Q-Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to IBM and IEEE Computer Society judges by addressing post-quantum cryptography readiness, a pressing and timely developer security concern.

ideas.pitch: A quantum binary optimization model for smart grid load balancing and renewable energy distribution during peak demand surges.
ideas.problem_statement: Explore real-world applications of quantum computing in smart infrastructure and green tech.
ideas.title: Q-Grid Flow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins points under the Quantum Impact Award by connecting quantum computing directly to sustainable energy infrastructure, a domain close to the organizing institute's priorities.
